allow: PowerShell($new = Get-Content "F:\\桌面\\rcsMap.json" -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json; $old = Get-Content "F:\\桌面\\rcsMap_backup_excel版.json" -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json; "新版本站点数: $\($new.stations.PSObject.Properties.Count\)"; $nFilled = 0; $replaced = @\(\); $newFilled = 0; foreach \($p in $new.stations.PSObject.Properties\) { $s = $p.Value; $oldS = $old.stations.$\($p.Name\); $oqr = [string]$oldS.qrCode; $nqr = [string]$s.qrCode; if \($nqr -ne ""\) { $nFilled++ }; if \($oqr -ne $nqr\) { if \($oqr -eq ""\) { $newFilled++ } else { $replaced += "$\($p.Name\) \(x=$\($s.x\),y=$\($s.y\)\): 旧[$oqr] -> 新[$nqr]" } } }; "非空码值: $nFilled / 1593"; "补填\(原空白\): $newFilled"; "替换\(原已有值被改\): $\($replaced.Count\)"; "---- 被替换明细 ----"; $replaced)

PowerShell($kc = Get-Content "F:\\桌面\\KCmap.json" -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json; $kcByCoord = @{}; foreach \($pt in $kc.pointList\) { if \($null -ne $pt.barCode\) { $kcByCoord["$\([int]$pt.x\),$\([int]$pt.y\)"] = [string][int]$pt.barCode } }; $rcs = Get-Content "F:\\桌面\\rcsMap.json" -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json; $mismatch = @\(\); $noPoint = @\(\); $matched = 0; foreach \($p in $rcs.stations.PSObject.Properties\) { $s = $p.Value; $key = "$\([int]$s.x\),$\([int]$s.y\)"; if \($kcByCoord.ContainsKey\($key\)\) { $matched++; $qr = [string]$s.qrCode; if \($qr -ne $kcByCoord[$key]\) { $mismatch += "$\($p.Name\) \($key\): 文件[$qr] vs KCmap[$\($kcByCoord[$key]\)]" } } else { $noPoint += "$\($p.Name\) \($key\) type=$\([int]$s.stationType\) qr=[$\($s.qrCode\)]" } }; "KCmap 匹配站点: $matched / 1593"; "不一致: $\($mismatch.Count\)"; $mismatch; "无KCmap点: $\($noPoint.Count\)"; $noPoint)
